answer: Each identity must register one pearl with a pigment signature at a set spectral distance from every earlier pearl in the same delta registry. The k-th identity tests about k samples at 15 each to find a free signature, so it pays 15k: 15 for the first, 150 for the tenth. N fakes cost 7.5N(N+1): 825 for 10, 75,750 for 100. Two pearls inside the distance void both at the close.
